name: @codecn-mac/desktop
description: codeCN desktop coding agent for macOS
author: codeCN

scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm run prepare:package-resources && pnpm run build:rust-core && pnpm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.package:mac:intel: pnpm run prepare:package-resources && pnpm run build:rust-core && pnpm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dmg zip --x64
scripts.package:mac:dir: pnpm run prepare:package-resources && pnpm run build:rust-core && pnpm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dir
scripts.test:main: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/main/atomic-file.test.ts src/main/workspace-catalog-durability.test.mjs src/shared/workspace-selection-errors.test.ts src/main/rollout-store.test.ts src/main/openai-wire.test.ts src/main/mcp-framing.test.ts src/main/desktop-control-plane.test.ts
scripts.test:storage: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/main/codex-storage.test.ts src/main/rollout-store.test.ts src/main/openai-wire.test.ts src/main/mcp-framing.test.ts src/main/desktop-control-plane.test.ts src/main/thread-message-reconciliation.test.ts
